title: Rulebricks Operations
description: Monitor Rulebricks execution, service health and infrastructure.

panels.title: Execution requests / second
panels.description: Completed execution requests per second. Each bulk request counts once; health checks are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP server error percentage
panels.description: Percentage of execution requests that return an HTTP 5xx response. No observations indicates no traffic in the selected window.

panels.title: Execution latency p95
panels.description: Estimated 95th-percentile processing time for execution requests, measured at HPS.

panels.title: Active execution requests
panels.description: Execution requests currently being processed across HPS replicas.

panels.title: Healthy worker consumers
panels.description: Workers reporting a healthy Kafka consumer. Compare with desired worker replicas to identify missing capacity.

panels.title: HPS log failure events / minute
panels.description: Decision-log publication failures reported by HPS per minute.

panels.title: Execution traffic by route and status
panels.description: Execution request rate by API route and HTTP status class.

panels.title: Execution latency
panels.description: Estimated execution latency at the 50th, 95th and 99th percentiles across HPS replicas.

panels.title: Worker messages by operation and outcome
panels.description: Worker message processing rate by operation and outcome. A message can contain multiple records; success indicates processing completed.

panels.title: Execution latency by stage
panels.description: 95th-percentile latency for HTTP handling, Kafka round trips and worker processing. Each stage is measured independently.

panels.title: App
panels.description: UP indicates metrics are available for at least the desired replica count. MISSING / DOWN indicates incomplete coverage; scaled-to-zero deployments show MISSING.

panels.title: HPS
panels.description: UP indicates metrics are available for at least the desired replica count. MISSING / DOWN indicates incomplete coverage; scaled-to-zero deployments show MISSING.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: UP indicates metrics are available for at least the desired replica count. MISSING / DOWN indicates incomplete coverage; scaled-to-zero deployments show MISSING.

panels.title: Kafka
panels.description: Availability of the Kafka consumer-lag exporter.

panels.title: Valkey
panels.description: Whether the metrics exporter can connect to Valkey.

panels.title: HTTP rejections by reason
panels.description: Rejected execution requests by route and reason.

panels.title: Kafka request failures
panels.description: Kafka request and response failures by operation and reason.

panels.title: Bulk records in successful requests
panels.description: Input records in bulk requests that completed without an HTTP error. Individual records may still have evaluation errors.

panels.title: Average chunks per bulk request
panels.description: Average number of work chunks dispatched for each bulk request.

panels.title: Chunk failures
panels.description: Failed work chunks by operation and reason.

panels.title: Planner queue wait estimate
panels.description: Highest estimated queue wait by operation, including transport overhead. Estimates retain their last value while idle.

panels.title: Observed chunk processing p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile processing time per work chunk, in milliseconds.

panels.title: Worker message processing p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile worker processing time per message. A bulk message can contain multiple records.

panels.title: Worker consumer health by pod
panels.description: Consumer health by worker: 0 indicates a fatal consumer failure; 1 indicates no reported fatal failure. Startup status does not confirm partition assignment.

panels.title: Worker heartbeat failures
panels.description: Kafka consumer heartbeat failures by error type and recovery outcome.

panels.title: HPS memory cache hit percentage
panels.description: Percentage of HPS memory-cache lookups served from cache.

panels.title: HPS memory cache occupancy
panels.description: Current entries and configured capacity across HPS memory caches.

panels.title: Redis operations by service
panels.description: Redis operations by service, operation and result, including background coordination requests.

panels.title: Redis operation latency p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile Redis operation latency by service and operation.

panels.title: Valkey memory
panels.description: Valkey memory usage and configured limit. A limit of zero means no memory cap is configured.

panels.title: Valkey evictions and rejected connections
panels.description: Valkey key evictions and rejected client connections per second.

panels.title: Authentication degradation
panels.description: Invalid API keys, cached authentication fallback and authentication-service unavailability.

panels.title: Response relay outcomes
panels.description: Response relay outcomes during consumer rebalancing. Stale or unroutable responses may require investigation.

panels.title: HPS log records published
panels.description: Decision-log records published by HPS, grouped by operation and result.

panels.title: HPS log bytes published
panels.description: Serialized decision-log bytes published by HPS per second.

panels.title: HPS log retry buffer records
panels.description: Decision-log records awaiting retry in HPS. Sustained growth can indicate broker connectivity problems.

panels.title: HPS log retry buffer bytes
panels.description: Memory occupied by decision-log records awaiting retry in HPS.

panels.title: HPS log failure and retry events
panels.description: HPS decision-log publication failures and records queued for retry.

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag by group and topic
panels.description: Messages awaiting consumption by Kafka consumer group and topic.

panels.title: Kafka broker request queues
panels.description: Requests and responses waiting in Kafka broker queues.

panels.title: Kafka broker failures
panels.description: Failed produce and fetch requests across Kafka brokers.

panels.title: Kafka messages by topic
panels.description: Messages received by Kafka brokers per topic.

panels.title: ClickHouse active queries
panels.description: Queries currently running in ClickHouse.

panels.title: App API requests by status
panels.description: Application API requests by HTTP status class, excluding health checks and metrics collection.

panels.title: App API latency p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile application API latency by route.

panels.title: App API rejections
panels.description: Application API requests rejected by reason.

panels.title: Frontend error reports
panels.description: Frontend error reports received by source. Repeated reports can come from the same user.

panels.title: Process resident memory
panels.description: Physical memory used by each selected process.

panels.title: V8 heap used
panels.description: JavaScript heap memory used by each selected process.

panels.title: Event loop p99 by pod
panels.description: 99th-percentile event-loop delay for each selected pod.

panels.title: Garbage collection time / second
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second for each selected pod.

panels.title: Deployment available and desired replicas
panels.description: Available replicas compared with the desired replica count for each deployment.

panels.title: Autoscaler current desired and maximum
panels.description: Current, desired and maximum replica counts for each autoscaler.

panels.title: Container CPU by pod
panels.description: CPU usage in cores for the 15 busiest Rulebricks pods.

panels.title: Container working set by pod
panels.description: Container working-set memory for the 15 Rulebricks pods using the most memory.

panels.title: Container CPU throttled periods
panels.description: Percentage of CPU scheduling periods in which a pod was throttled.

panels.title: Persistent volume usage
panels.description: Percentage of persistent-volume capacity in use.

panels.title: Pod restarts in selected time range
panels.description: Container restarts during the selected time range, grouped by pod.

panels.title: Pending and unschedulable pods
panels.description: Rulebricks pods waiting to run or unable to be scheduled.

panels.title: Release pin resolution sources
panels.description: Release resolution rate by lookup source.

panels.title: Observed context batch admission
panels.description: Observed context records by admission outcome. Distributed batch coverage may be incomplete.

panels.title: Learned planner cost per item
panels.description: Highest estimated processing cost per item across HPS planners. Estimates retain their last value while idle.

panels.title: Learned planner cost per byte
panels.description: Highest estimated processing cost per input byte across HPS planners. Estimates retain their last value while idle.
